target: Single bean leaf area below training median is SMALL; at or above is BIG. Lower and upper class medians are descriptive anchors only.
original_image_policy: One actual published camera capture per leaf; no generated views, composites or augmentation. Source publisher crop/resize to 512x512 retained without adding transformed views.
baseline: Existing controlled-mat inference, with the published custom marker family enabled; safety gates unchanged.
diagnostic: Oracle annotated leaf mask plus detected physical marker, separately labelled as a geometric ceiling. Never reported as automatic size accuracy.
candidate: Unchanged dominant-component pixel RF. Marker-area scalar weak-perspective area estimate; explicitly approximate, never a validated physical plane claim.
selection: User-specified median definition, not selected by evaluation performance. Source test outcomes were already observed during V3; any test rerun is a post-test diagnostic.
pilot_inspection: Leaf 001 image, XML and oracle geometry were inspected for format/marker compatibility. Report this development pilot separately from clean held-out results.
known_scope_limits: One bean-leaf crop and one source camera/geography.
Not automatic species identification, every vegetable, or physical station field qualification.
Leaf non-planarity and manual measurement error can limit physical-size decisions.
single_change: Use the measured training-specimen median instead of mean; identical random forest, physical scaling, guard band and split.
additional_limitations: Source test was previously observed during V3 development; V4 test results are post-test diagnostics, not a new independent test.
Mean-based and median-based scores have different target labels; score changes alone do not demonstrate a better measurement model.
